visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a white blouse and a khaki skirt with brown work boots, dances playfully in front of a large, glowing blue 'G' logo in a dark, neon-lit room. (2) The scene shifts to her walking through a brightly lit office space filled with black gaming chairs and dual-monitor computer setups featuring illuminated keyboards and mice. (3) A male presenter in a black blazer stands in a studio area with multiple screens, gesturing while speaking to the camera. (4) Close-up shots show precision testing equipment in a white laboratory, including a computer mouse on a rotating mechanical platter and an antenna in an anechoic chamber with blue foam spikes. (5) A middle-aged man with a long grey beard and black t-shirt (Chris Pate) sits on a grey sofa, talking and gesturing during an interview with the host. (6) The video ends with the host, the male presenter, and the bearded man posing together while holding pink Logitech peripherals, including a headset, keyboard, and mouse.

(6) [Subtitle]: 在新竹其實有間很大的亞太研發中心. (7) [Subtitle]: 電競滑鼠的極速性能測試. (8) [Subtitle]: 裝置的無線訊號環境測試等等. (9) [Subtitle]: 但整個Logic G系列的背後是這個男人. (10) [Subtitle]: 首席產品經理 Chris Pate. (11) [Subtitle]: 他已經在羅技服務快30年了. (12) [Subtitle]: 問 Chris 最近熱愛工作的 Moment 是什麼時候?. (13) [Subtitle]: 第一個回答超可愛. (14) [Variety]: 壓力山大. (15) [Subtitle]: How can I make the engineer stressed?. (16) [Subtitle]: 沒有啦開玩笑. (17) [Subtitle]: I get to work with really smart people doing really cool stuff. (18) [Subtitle]: 可以和一群最聰明的人一起做超酷的事. (19) [Subtitle]: And I get to solve hard problems with them. (20) [Subtitle]: 並與他們一起為全世界. (21) [Subtitle]: for the best gamers in the world. (22) [Subtitle]: 頂尖玩家解決各種問題. (23) [Subtitle]: 好圈粉喔. (24) [Subtitle]: Chris 也說跟玩家交流很有技巧. (25) [Subtitle]: 除了聽他們說什麼，更重要的是. (26) [Subtitle]: 看他們怎麼操作硬體. (27) [Subtitle]: 挖掘玩家的真正需求. (28) [Subtitle]: 羅技很多重要的技術都是這樣研發的. (29) [Slogan]: 想了解更多到電獺少女官網看完整採訪. [Logo]: @aottergirls.
